title: Completed coefficient right-unit maps with integral normalization
statement: Fix the finite-field and coefficient datum and a separated finite-type $k_0$-scheme $X_0$, with $X=X_0\times_{k_0}k$, as in [def-wf-weil-category]. Let $E$ be a finite coefficient field and let $R=\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,X}$. Use the actual ordinary derived tensor underlying [def-wf-tensor-product], and let $C$ and $u$ be its Koszul completion and unit of [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-koszul-completion-reflector]. For the finite coefficient comparison $J_E$ of [lem-fd-rational-coefficient-category-comparison], transported to the actual Weil categories by [def-wf-weil-coefficient-comparison-interface], identify the image of the constant integral object of [def-weil-constant-weil-structure] with $R[0]$ by the coefficient-section map and the single-complex derived transport. Define the ordinary right unitor $r_M:M\otimes_R^LR\to M$ by the map $x\otimes a\mapsto ax$ on every flat K-flat representative, natural in all derived arrows. For each complete integral constructible representative $K$, define its completed right unitor $\widehat r_K:C(K\otimes_R^LR)\to K$ as the unique extension of $r_K$ through the reflector unit; equivalently it is $u_K^{-1}C(r_K)$. Rationalize these maps on the unchanged objects and localized arrows. This defines the completed rational right-unit map with the actual constant coefficient object, retaining the prescribed integral and ordinary representative normalizations.
